en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a small European town square or park. In the foreground is a geometric stone fountain basin with several spouts spraying water into a pool. At the top of the fountain, on an axial stairway leading up a grassy slope, stands a bust of a man on a tall pedestal flanked by plaques. Young trees and paths curve through the landscaped park. In the background are multi‑story masonry and stucco buildings with steep gabled roofs and dormers. One long building along the back wall bears a painted sign in German, and the street at right has shopfronts with awnings.
